l05-saumon-gratine-brocoli-cheddar.t: Salmon and broccoli gratin with cheddar
s: Preheat the oven to 190 °C and butter a gratin dish.
Cut the broccoli into small florets and blanch them for 3 minutes in salted boiling water. Drain.
Cut the salmon into 3 cm cubes.
Spread the broccoli and salmon in the dish.
Whisk the cream with the egg, mustard, half of the cheddar, chives, salt and pepper; pour over the salmon.
Top with the remaining cheddar and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden.
l05-saumon-gratine-brocoli-cheddar.p: The gratin can be assembled the day before and kept raw, covered, in the refrigerator; add 5 minutes to the cooking time.

l05-crevettes-saute-chou-sesame.t: Prawn stir-fry with Chinese cabbage, mushrooms and sesame
s: Slice the cabbage into 1 cm strips, the mushrooms into thin slices and the spring onions into short lengths.
Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a wok over very high heat and sear the prawns for 2 minutes. Set aside.
Add the remaining oil, the garlic, ginger and chilli, and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the mushrooms and cabbage and stir-fry for 4 minutes, stirring constantly.
Return the prawns, add the soy sauce and spring onions, and mix for 1 minute.
Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and serve.
l05-crevettes-saute-chou-sesame.p: Cut all the ingredients before you light the heat: wok cooking goes very fast.

l05-dorade-grillee-tahini.t: Grilled sea bream fillets with tahini sauce and herb salad
s: Whisk the tahini with half of the lemon juice, the grated garlic, the water and a pinch of salt until you have a smooth, coating sauce.
Roughly chop the parsley and mint, then add the diced cucumber and halved cherry tomatoes. Season with 2 tbsp of oil and the rest of the lemon juice.
Brush the sea bream fillets with the remaining oil and sprinkle with cumin, salt and pepper.
Grill them for 3 minutes skin-side down, then 1 to 2 minutes flesh-side down in a very hot grill pan.
Serve the fillets on the herb salad and spoon over the tahini sauce.
l05-dorade-grillee-tahini.p: If the tahini sauce thickens while waiting, loosen it with a spoonful of water.

s: Beat the eggs with the chives, salt and pepper.
Heat half of the butter in a 24 cm frying pan over medium heat and sauté the prawns for 1 minute. Set aside.
Add the remaining butter, pour in half of the eggs and let set for 2 minutes, pulling the edges toward the centre.
While the top is still slightly runny, spread half of the cream cheese and prawns over it, roll up the omelette and slide it onto a plate.
Repeat for the second omelette.
Serve with the rocket drizzled with olive oil.
l05-omelette-crevettes-ciboulette.p: Add a few diced avocado pieces to the filling for extra richness and creaminess.

l05-boulettes-sardines-sauce-tomate-basi.t: Fresh sardine balls in tomato and basil sauce
s: Chop the sardine fillets with a knife or pulse them in a food processor, without turning them into a purée.
Mix with the egg, almond flour, parsley, half of the chopped garlic, salt and pepper. Chill for 15 minutes.
With wet hands, shape into walnut-sized balls.
Brown them for 4 minutes in 2 tbsp of oil, turning gently. Set aside.
In the same pan, fry the remaining garlic for 30 seconds, add the tomatoes, season with salt and simmer for 10 minutes.
Return the balls to the sauce and simmer, covered, for 8 minutes.
Sauté the courgette spaghetti for 2 minutes in the remaining oil and serve with the balls, basil and Parmesan.
l05-boulettes-sardines-sauce-tomate-basi.p: The balls can be frozen raw on a tray, then bagged: add them straight from the freezer to the sauce and cook 5 minutes longer.

l05-merlan-papillote-coco-citronnelle.t: Whiting baked in parchment with coconut milk and ginger
s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Mix the coconut milk, ginger, turmeric, soy sauce and lime juice.
Cut the pepper into thin strips.
On 4 sheets of baking parchment, place a handful of spinach, then a whiting fillet and a few pepper strips.
Fold up the edges and pour 3 tbsp of coconut sauce over each fish. Seal tightly.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes.
Open, sprinkle with coriander and serve with cauliflower rice.
l05-merlan-papillote-coco-citronnelle.p: Fold the edges over several times: the sauce must not leak out during cooking.

l05-saumon-fume-roules-fromage-concombre.t: Smoked salmon and cream cheese rolls with cucumber salad
s: Mix the cream cheese with half of the dill, the lemon zest and some pepper.
Spread a thin layer on each slice of smoked salmon and roll up tightly. Chill for 10 minutes, then cut into 3 cm pieces.
Slice the cucumber thinly and mix with the yoghurt, the remaining dill, the lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Dry-toast the pumpkin seeds for 2 minutes in a frying pan.
Arrange the rocket, cucumber salad and rolls on plates, and sprinkle with pumpkin seeds.
l05-saumon-fume-roules-fromage-concombre.p: Smoked salmon is already salty: add very little salt to the cucumber salad.

l05-thon-poele-poivrons-oignons.t: Pan-seared tuna steaks with soft peppers and olives
s: Cut the peppers into strips and slice the onion thinly.
Soften them for 15 minutes over medium heat in 3 tbsp of oil with the garlic, stirring often.
Add the paprika, olives and vinegar, season with salt and cook for 3 minutes. Keep warm.
Brush the tuna steaks with the remaining oil, then season with salt and pepper.
Sear them in a very hot pan for 2 minutes per side for a pink centre, or 3 minutes for more well-done tuna.
Serve on the peppers and sprinkle with parsley.
l05-thon-poele-poivrons-oignons.p: Don't overcook the tuna: beyond 3 minutes per side, it becomes dry.

l05-salade-calamars-tiede-roquette.t: Warm squid salad with rocket, feta and olives
s: Pat the squid rings thoroughly dry.
Make the dressing: 3 tbsp of oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt and pepper.
Arrange the rocket, halved cherry tomatoes, diced cucumber, olives and crumbled feta in a large dish.
Heat the remaining oil over very high heat and sear the squid with the crushed garlic for 2 minutes, stirring.
Pour the hot squid over the salad, drizzle with the dressing and serve immediately.
l05-salade-calamars-tiede-roquette.p: The heat of the squid slightly melts the feta: serve without waiting.

i: bay leaf, thyme and coriander seeds
s: Cut the carrot into very thin rounds, the red onion into slices and the pepper into thin strips.
Sauté the vegetables and garlic for 3 minutes in 2 tbsp of oil, add the vinegar, water, spices, salt and pepper; simmer for 5 minutes.
Salt the mackerel fillets and brown them for 2 minutes skin-side down and 1 minute flesh-side down in the remaining oil.
Place the fillets in a deep dish and pour the hot marinade and vegetables over them.
Let cool, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours (ideally overnight).
Serve cold with the green salad, drizzled with a little marinade.
l05-maquereau-escabeche-legumes.p: The escabeche keeps for 4 days in the refrigerator and improves with time.

l05-chaudree-poisson-chou-fleur.t: White fish and seafood chowder with cauliflower
s: Melt the butter in a large pot and sweat the sliced onion and celery for 5 minutes.
Add the cauliflower in small florets and the stock, bring to the boil and cook for 12 minutes.
Take out a third of the cauliflower with a little stock, blend it into a purée and return it to the pot to thicken.
Add the cream and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the fish and poach for 4 minutes, then add the prawns and mussels and cook for 2 minutes.
Adjust the seasoning and serve in bowls sprinkled with chives.
l05-chaudree-poisson-chou-fleur.p: A comforting meal-in-a-bowl soup: make the base the day before and add the seafood when reheating.

l05-crevettes-gratinees-ail-fromage.t: Garlic and mozzarella baked prawns with green salad
s: Preheat the oven to 220 °C.
Fry the chopped garlic for 30 seconds in 1 tbsp of oil, add the tomatoes and oregano, and reduce for 5 minutes.
Divide the sauce among 4 small baking dishes, add the raw prawns, then season with salt and pepper.
Top with the grated mozzarella.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the cheese is golden and the prawns are pink.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with the lettuce dressed with the remaining oil and the vinegar.
l05-crevettes-gratinees-ail-fromage.p: Serve in the baking dishes while still sizzling, with a spoon to scoop up the sauce.

l05-cabillaud-paprika-puree-celeri.t: Roasted smoked paprika cod loin with celeriac and cauliflower mash
s: Peel the celeriac and cut it into cubes, break the cauliflower into florets and boil everything for 20 minutes in salted water until tender.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Mix the smoked paprika, grated garlic, oil and a pinch of salt.
Brush the cod loins with this mixture and place them in a dish.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the flesh is opaque and flaky.
Drain the vegetables and blend them with the butter and cream. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve the cod on the mash, with a squeeze of lemon and parsley.
l05-cabillaud-paprika-puree-celeri.p: Celeriac makes a mild, slightly sweet mash that children love.

l05-wraps-nori-thon-avocat.t: Nori wraps with tuna, avocado and omelette
i: cans of tuna in oil, drained
s: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and make a thin omelette in an oiled pan. Let cool and cut into strips.
Mix the flaked tuna with the mayonnaise and some pepper.
Cut the avocado and cucumber into sticks.
Place a nori sheet shiny side down, then put a lettuce leaf, tuna, omelette, avocado and cucumber on the bottom third.
Roll up tightly, moisten the edge of the nori with a wet finger to seal. Cut in half.
Serve with the soy sauce for dipping.
l05-wraps-nori-thon-avocat.p: Make them at the last minute: nori softens when it comes into contact with moisture.

l05-loup-four-artichauts-citron.t: Baked sea bass fillets with artichokes and preserved lemon
s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C.
Cut the artichoke hearts into quarters and toss them in a dish with the cherry tomatoes, sliced garlic, 2 tbsp of oil, salt and pepper. Bake for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, rinse the preserved lemon peel and cut it into thin strips.
Place the sea bass fillets skin-side down on the vegetables, add the olives and preserved lemon, and drizzle with the remaining oil.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the flesh is opaque.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve.
l05-loup-four-artichauts-citron.p: Preserved lemon is salty: add only a little salt to the fish.

l05-salade-saumon-roti-brocoli-amandes.t: Main-course salad with roasted salmon, broccoli and toasted almonds
s: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Cut the broccoli into small florets and toss with 1 tbsp of oil, salt and pepper on a baking tray.
Place the salmon on the same tray and season with paprika, salt and pepper.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes: the broccoli should be lightly charred and the salmon just cooked.
Dry-toast the almonds for 2 minutes in a frying pan.
Whisk the mustard, lemon and the remaining oil.
Arrange the spinach, broccoli, sliced avocado and flaked salmon; drizzle with the dressing and sprinkle with almonds.
l05-salade-saumon-roti-brocoli-amandes.p: Works as meal-prep boxes for 3 days: add the avocado and dressing on the day.

s: Scrub and rinse the mussels, remove the beards, and discard any that are broken.
In a large pot, fry the chopped onion, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes in the coconut oil.
Add the curry powder and stir for 30 seconds, then pour in the coconut milk.
Add the mussels, cover and cook over high heat for 5 minutes, shaking the pot.
Add the prawns, cover again and cook for 2 minutes, until all the mussels have opened.
Sprinkle with coriander and serve in deep plates with the sauce.
l05-moules-curry-coco.p: The prawns round out the protein: mussels alone are a bit light for a main course.

l05-galettes-saumon-sauce-yaourt-aneth.t: Salmon and courgette patties with dill yoghurt sauce
s: Grate the courgette, salt it and let it drain for 10 minutes, then squeeze it firmly in a tea towel.
Chop the salmon with a knife into small dice.
Mix the salmon, courgette, egg, almond flour, spring onions, half of the dill, salt and pepper. Shape into 8 patties.
Brown them for 4 minutes per side in the oil over medium heat.
Mix the yoghurt with the remaining dill, the lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Serve the patties with the sauce and salad.
l05-galettes-saumon-sauce-yaourt-aneth.p: A good way to use salmon trimmings, which the fishmonger often sells cheaper.

l06-tajine-agneau-artichauts.t: Lamb tagine with artichoke hearts and fennel
i: ginger, turmeric, white pepper and saffron
s: In a casserole, brown the lamb in the oil for 8 min over high heat with the onion, garlic, spices and salt until well browned.
Add 600 ml of hot water and the coriander, cover and simmer for 1 h over low heat.
Meanwhile, rub the artichoke hearts with lemon to stop them from darkening and cut the fennel into quarters.
Arrange the artichokes and fennel around the meat and add the preserved lemon peel cut into strips.
Cover and continue for 25 to 30 min, until the vegetables are tender when pierced with a knife tip.
Reduce the sauce uncovered for 5 min if it is too thin, then serve in the cooking dish.
l06-tajine-agneau-artichauts.p: Out of season, frozen artichoke hearts work very well: add them straight in, without thawing.

l06-tajine-poisson-chermoula.t: Fish tagine with chermoula and peppers
i: sea bass or sea bream, in thick slices
s: Blend the coriander, parsley, garlic, spices, lemon juice, oil and salt to make the chermoula; coat the fish with half of it and marinate for 30 min in the fridge.
Line the base of the tagine with celery stalks cut into sticks: they act as a rack and stop the fish from sticking.
Place the fish on top, then the tomato slices and pepper strips; pour over the remaining chermoula diluted in 100 ml of water.
Cover and cook for 30 min over low heat on a heat diffuser (or 35 min in the oven at 190 °C).
Add the olives 5 min before the end and check the fish: the flesh should come away easily from the bone.
Serve in the tagine, drizzled with raw olive oil.
l06-tajine-poisson-chermoula.p: Double the chermoula and keep a jar in the fridge under a layer of oil: it keeps for 5 days and flavours grilled meats and vegetables.

l06-tajine-boeuf-chou-fleur.t: Beef tagine with cauliflower and olives
i: ras el hanout, ginger and turmeric
s: Brown the beef cubes in the oil and smen for 10 min over high heat, in batches, so they colour well.
Add the onion, garlic, spices, salt and pepper; stir for 3 min until fragrant.
Add 700 ml of hot water and the coriander bunch, cover and simmer for 1 h 15 over low heat.
Add the cauliflower florets and the rinsed olives; cover and continue for 20 min, without stirring too much so the florets stay whole.
Remove the coriander bunch and, if needed, reduce the sauce uncovered for 5 min before serving.
l06-tajine-boeuf-chou-fleur.p: This tagine reheats very well: make a double batch and freeze individual portions (up to 3 months).

s: Wash and thoroughly dry the coriander and parsley, then remove the thick stems.
Finely chop the herbs with a knife (or pulse in a blender to keep some texture) together with the peeled garlic.
Add the cumin, paprika, cayenne, salt, lemon juice and vinegar; mix.
Drizzle in the olive oil while stirring until you have a loose paste, then let rest for 15 min before using.
l06-chermoula-verte.p: Use it as a marinade for fish, prawns or chicken, or as a sauce for eggs and grilled vegetables. Storage: 5 days in the fridge, covered with oil.

i: ras el hanout, cinnamon and ginger
s: Rub the meat with the ras el hanout, ginger, half of the cinnamon, salt, grated onion, smen and oil.
Put everything in a casserole, brown for 5 min, then pour in 700 ml of water; cover and simmer for 1 h 30 over low heat.
Meanwhile, dry-toast the almonds in a frying pan for 5 min, stirring, or fry them in a little oil.
When the meat falls off the bone, add the erythritol and the remaining cinnamon; reduce uncovered for 20 to 25 min until you have a syrupy sauce that coats the meat.
Serve garnished with the golden almonds.
l06-mrouzia-sans-miel.p: Erythritol doesn't caramelise like honey: it is the slow reduction of the sauce and the smen that give the glazed texture. A pinch of stevia boosts the sweetness if needed.

l06-bastilla-poulet-feuilles-oeuf.t: Keto chicken bastilla with egg sheets
i: eggs (4 for the filling, 6 for the sheets)
s: Cook the chicken for 45 min covered with the onion, spices (except the cinnamon), herbs, 20 g of butter, salt and 250 ml of water; shred the meat and set aside the sauce.
Reduce the sauce by half, add 4 beaten eggs and stir over low heat until you have soft scrambled eggs; drain.
Make the sheets: beat 6 eggs with the cream and a pinch of salt, then make 6 very thin crêpes in a buttered 26 cm frying pan (1 min per side).
Mix the crushed almonds with the erythritol and half of the cinnamon.
In a buttered tin, arrange 4 egg sheets in a star with the edges overhanging; spread the scrambled eggs, the chicken, then the almonds.
Fold the edges over, cover with the last 2 sheets and brush with melted butter.
Bake for 15 min at 200 °C, then sprinkle with a pinch of cinnamon before serving.
l06-bastilla-poulet-feuilles-oeuf.p: For a crispier version, replace the egg lid with a thinly rolled fathead dough (mozzarella + almond flour).

i: ras el hanout, turmeric and pepper
s: Brown the chicken in the oil with the onion, celery and spices for 6 min.
Add the grated tomato and 1.3 l of water, cover and cook for 30 min.
Remove the chicken, shred it discarding the skin and bones, then return the meat to the soup with the courgette.
Rinse the konjac vermicelli thoroughly under hot water, cut it with scissors and add it; cook for 8 min.
Finish with the coriander and crumbled dried mint, then serve with a squeeze of lemon.
l06-chorba-poulet-vermicelles-konjac.p: Rinsing and draining the konjac well removes its odour; a minute in a dry frying pan before adding it improves its texture even more.

s: Prick the aubergines and char them directly over a gas flame or for 30 min under the oven grill at 240 °C, turning them, until the skin is blackened.
Let cool for 5 min, peel them and chop the flesh with a knife.
Peel and chop the tomatoes; fry them for 5 min in the oil with the garlic.
Add the aubergine flesh, cumin, paprika, salt and herbs; mash with a fork and let cook down for 10 min over low heat, stirring.
Off the heat, add the lemon juice and a drizzle of olive oil; serve warm or cold.
l06-zaalouk-aubergines.p: Zaalouk is even better the next day; it keeps for 4 days in the fridge in an airtight container.

l06-chlada-tomates-poivrons.t: Moroccan chlada with tomato, pepper and cucumber
s: Cut the tomatoes, deseeded pepper and cucumber into small, even dice (5 mm).
Very finely chop the red onion and the herbs.
In a bowl, whisk the oil, lemon juice, cumin and salt.
Toss the vegetables with the dressing just before serving so they stay crunchy.
l06-chlada-tomates-poivrons.p: Add a few black olives and a spoonful of crumbled feta for a Moroccan-style savoury breakfast.

l06-brochettes-kefta-grill.t: Kefta skewers with cumin and fresh onion
s: Squeeze the grated onion in your hands to extract the juice, then mix it into the kefta with the herbs, spices, salt and pepper.
Knead for 3 min to get a well-bound mixture, then rest for 20 min in the fridge.
With wet hands, shape into elongated sausages around flat skewers (about 80 g each).
Brush with oil and grill for 10 to 12 min on the barbecue or under the oven grill at 240 °C, turning every 3 min.
Serve with a chlada and a yoghurt and cumin sauce.
l06-brochettes-kefta-grill.p: Flat skewers stop the kefta from spinning around itself during cooking.

l06-boulfaf-foie-agneau.t: Keto boulfaf: chicken liver and lamb skewers
i: fatty lamb in cubes (saddle or boneless chops)
s: Clean the livers by removing the membranes and cut into large pieces; cut the lamb into cubes of the same size.
Mix the cumin, paprika, chilli and salt on a plate.
Thread onto skewers, alternating liver and lamb, then brush lightly with oil.
Grill for 12 to 15 min over hot coals, turning often, until the liver is no longer pink in the centre (70 °C).
Roll the hot skewers in the spice mix and serve sprinkled with parsley.
l06-boulfaf-foie-agneau.p: Traditionally made at Eid with lamb liver wrapped in caul fat: use it if you have it, the recipe works the same.

i: cumin, paprika and a little saffron
s: Take the shoulder out 1 h ahead. Mix the smen with the garlic, half of the cumin, the paprika, saffron and salt.
Score the meat in deep diamonds and massage generously with this spiced butter.
Place it in a dish with 300 ml of water, cover with aluminium foil and roast for 3 h at 160 °C, basting every 45 min.
Remove the foil, raise the oven to 220 °C and brown for 30 to 40 min, basting, until the skin is crisp.
The meat should pull apart by hand. Serve with the remaining cumin mixed with salt in a small dish.
l06-mechoui-epaule-four.p: Mechoui is eaten with the fingers, dipped in the cumin and salt mix: serve it with a large Moroccan salad.

i: beef shank or chuck, in large pieces
cumin, ras el hanout and saffron
s: Put the meat in a tanjia (clay urn) or a cast-iron casserole.
Add the smen, oil, unpeeled garlic cloves, preserved lemon, spices, salt and water; mix.
Seal with string-tied baking parchment (for the tanjia) or the casserole lid.
Bake for 5 h at 140 °C without opening: the meat confits in its own juices.
Shake the urn, pour the meat and its sauce into a dish and serve with a tomato salad.
l06-tanjia-marrakchia.p: Traditionally, the tanjia cooks all night in the embers of the hammam furnace: your oven at low temperature gives a very similar result.

l06-rfissa-keto-poulet.t: Keto chicken rfissa with almond and fenugreek flatbreads
i: ras el hanout, ground fenugreek, ginger and saffron
s: Brown the chicken in the smen with the onion, spices and salt for 8 min, then add 1 l of water; add the coriander and simmer for 50 min.
Meanwhile, melt the mozzarella for 1 min in the microwave, add the almond flour, psyllium and egg; knead until you have a smooth dough.
Roll the dough out thinly between two sheets of baking parchment and cook for 3 to 4 min per side in a hot, lightly oiled pan.
Cut these flatbreads into 1 cm strips.
Remove the chicken; reduce the broth for 10 min so that it thickens.
Arrange the strips in a large dish, moisten with broth, place the chicken in the centre and pour the remaining sauce over. Serve immediately.
l06-rfissa-keto-poulet.p: Fenugreek is essential to rfissa: it gives it its characteristic aroma. The strips can be made the day before.

l06-briouates-kefta-fathead.t: Keto kefta briouats in fathead dough
s: Cook the kefta with the onion, parsley, spices and salt for 8 min; off the heat, bind with 1 beaten egg and let cool.
Melt the mozzarella and cream cheese for 1 min 30 in the microwave, stir, then add the almond flour and the other egg; knead.
Roll the dough out to 2 mm between two sheets of baking parchment and cut strips 8 cm wide.
Place a spoonful of filling at the end of each strip and fold into a triangle like a traditional briouat.
Arrange on a baking tray and bake for 15 to 18 min at 200 °C, until well browned.
l06-briouates-kefta-fathead.p: If the dough sticks, chill it for 10 min before cutting.

s: Mash the jben and feta with a fork together with the herbs, pepper and 1 egg yolk (keep the white).
Make the dough: melt the mozzarella in the microwave, add the almond flour and the remaining egg, and knead.
Roll out thinly between two sheets of baking parchment, cut strips 8 cm wide and place a spoonful of filling on each.
Fold into triangles, brush with the egg white and bake for 15 to 18 min at 200 °C.
l06-briouates-jben-herbes.p: Perfect for the ftour table: make them ahead and reheat for 5 min in the oven.

l06-the-menthe-sans-sucre.t: Sugar-free mint tea with toasted almonds
i: water for the gunpowder green tea (2 tsp of tea)
boiling water to rinse the tea
toasted almonds (to nibble with the tea)
s: Put 2 tsp of gunpowder green tea in the teapot, pour in 50 ml of boiling water, swirl, and discard this water to remove the bitterness.
Add 800 ml of simmering water and infuse for 3 min over very low heat.
Add the washed, packed mint and the stevia; infuse for 2 min off the heat.
Pour a glass and pour it back into the teapot two or three times to mix well, then serve, pouring from a height to create foam, with the toasted almonds.
l06-the-menthe-sans-sucre.p: In winter, add a few leaves of chiba (wormwood) or louiza (lemon verbena) for variety.

l06-salade-concombre-menthe.t: Cucumber salad with mint and orange blossom water
s: Grate the cucumbers on the coarse holes of a grater (or cut them into very thin sticks); drain them for 5 min in a colander.
Mix the vinegar, erythritol, orange blossom water, oil and salt.
Pour over the cucumber, add the chopped mint and toss.
Chill for 15 min before serving very cold.
l06-salade-concombre-menthe.p: Add a pinch of cumin or dried oregano (zaatar) for a more fragrant version.

l06-tajine-boulettes-sardines.t: Sardine ball tagine in tomato sauce
s: Remove the backbone and skin of the sardines; chop the flesh with a knife with half of the herbs, 2 cloves of garlic, half of the spices, the salt and the egg.
With wet hands, shape into walnut-sized balls.
In a tagine, heat the oil with the remaining garlic, add the tomatoes, the remaining spices and 100 ml of water; simmer for 10 min.
Place the balls in the sauce, cover and cook for 15 min over low heat without stirring.
Sprinkle with the remaining herbs, drizzle with lemon and serve.
l06-tajine-boulettes-sardines.p: An emblematic dish of Safi and Essaouira, economical and rich in omega-3. The raw balls freeze very well.

l06-couscous-chou-fleur-agneau.t: Keto cauliflower couscous with lamb and vegetables
i: ras el hanout, ginger, turmeric and saffron
s: In the base of the couscoussier, brown the lamb for 8 min with half of the smen, the onion, tomato, spices and salt; add 1.5 l of water and the bunch of herbs, and cook covered for 1 h.
Add the turnip and cabbage, then the courgettes 10 min later; continue for 20 min until all the vegetables are tender.
Meanwhile, grate the cauliflower (or pulse it in a blender) until it forms grains the size of semolina.
Put the cauliflower semolina in the top of the couscoussier and steam it over the broth for 10 min, uncovered.
Pour it into a dish, add the butter and the remaining smen, then fluff with a fork while sprinkling with 2 ladles of broth.
Shape into a dome, make a well in the centre, place the meat in it and arrange the vegetables around. Serve the broth separately.
l06-couscous-chou-fleur-agneau.p: Don't blend the cauliflower too much: the semolina should stay in grains. It can also be dry-fried for 6 min if you don't have a couscoussier.

l06-seffa-konjac-poulet.t: Keto seffa with konjac vermicelli and chicken
s: Cook the chicken with the onion, smen, spices (except the cinnamon), salt and 400 ml of water, covered, for 40 min, then shred the meat.
Reduce the sauce until it coats the spoon and return the chicken to it.
Rinse the konjac vermicelli in hot water, drain, and dry them for 3 min in a dry frying pan, then add the butter and stir for 2 min.
Mix the almonds with the erythritol and cinnamon.
In a deep dish, place the chicken in its sauce, cover with the vermicelli in a dome and decorate with rays of cinnamon almonds.
l06-seffa-konjac-poulet.p: Serve the seffa with a glass of almond milk, as festive tradition has it.

l06-poulet-mhammer-four.t: Oven-roasted mhammer chicken with smen and saffron sauce
s: Mix the smen, garlic, spices, lemon, half of the coriander and the salt; massage the chicken inside and out and rest for 30 min.
Place it in a casserole with the grated onion and 400 ml of water; cover and cook for 45 min over low heat, turning it once.
Transfer the chicken to an ovenproof dish and roast for 25 min at 220 °C, basting with its juices, until the skin is deep red and crisp.
Meanwhile, reduce the casserole sauce with the olives for 10 min.
Pour the sauce over the chicken and sprinkle with the remaining coriander.
l06-poulet-mhammer-four.p: "Mhammer" means "reddened": it is the oven finish after cooking in sauce that gives the colour and the crispness.

s: Brown the veal in the oil for 6 min with the onion, garlic and spices.
Add the grated tomato, parsley, salt, pepper and 400 ml of water; cover and simmer for 50 min over low heat.
Add the green beans, cut in half, and continue for 20 min covered.
Uncover and reduce for 5 min: the sauce should be short and coat the meat.
Serve hot with a drizzle of olive oil.
l06-tajine-veau-haricots-verts.p: Frozen green beans work very well: add them straight in, reducing the cooking time to 15 min.

l06-tajine-agneau-celeri.t: Lamb tagine with celery and preserved lemon
s: Brown the lamb in the oil with the onion, garlic, spices and salt for 8 min.
Add 600 ml of water, cover and cook for 1 h over low heat.
String the celery stalks, cut them into 6 cm pieces and chop the leaves; blanch them for 3 min in boiling water to remove the bitterness.
Add the celery, leaves, preserved lemon cut into strips and olives around the meat.
Cover and continue for 25 min, then reduce the sauce uncovered for 5 min before serving.
l06-tajine-agneau-celeri.p: A classic from Fez ("lklafess"): choose a very green, tender celery for a fragrant tagine.

s: In a clay dish or frying pan, heat the oil over medium heat with the garlic and chilli for 1 min, without browning.
Add the grated tomato and spices, and reduce for 3 min.
Add the prawns and salt; cook for 3 to 4 min, stirring, until pink and firm.
Off the heat, add the coriander and lemon juice; serve sizzling in the cooking dish.
l06-crevettes-pil-pil.p: Don't overcook the prawns: beyond 4 min, they turn rubbery.

l06-tajine-calamars-tomate.t: Squid and prawn tagine with chermoula
s: Blend the coriander, parsley, garlic, spices, lemon, half of the oil and the salt to make a chermoula; mix it with the squid and marinate for 15 min.
Heat the remaining oil in a tagine or sauté pan, add the squid and sauté for 5 min over high heat.
Add the chopped tomatoes, cover and simmer for 30 min over low heat, until the squid is tender.
Add the prawns and black olives, cook uncovered for 4 min until the prawns turn pink, then serve.
l06-tajine-calamars-tomate.p: Squid should be cooked either very quickly (2 min) or for a long time (30 min or more): in between, it toughens.

l06-tajine-legumes-oeufs-jben.t: Garden vegetable tagine with eggs and jben
s: Fry the aubergine in the oil for 5 min in the tagine, then add the garlic, chopped tomato, spices and salt.
Arrange the cauliflower, courgettes and pepper strips, pour in 150 ml of water, cover and cook for 20 min over low heat.
Make 6 nests between the vegetables and crack the eggs into them; sprinkle with the crumbled jben.
Cover and cook for another 6 to 8 min, until the whites are set.
Sprinkle with coriander and serve in the tagine.
l06-tajine-legumes-oeufs-jben.p: A complete vegetarian dish; replace the jben with feta for a saltier taste.

l06-dorade-four-chermoula.t: Baked sea bream with chermoula and tomatoes
i: whole gutted sea bream (600 g each)
s: Make the chermoula by blending the herbs, garlic, spices, lemon juice, oil and salt.
Cut 3 slashes on each side of the sea bream, coat them with chermoula inside and out, and marinate for 20 min.
In an oiled ovenproof dish, make a bed of tomatoes and pepper; place the fish on top and add the preserved lemon peel.
Pour over 100 ml of water, cover with aluminium foil and bake for 20 min at 200 °C.
Remove the foil and continue for 10 min to brown the skin; serve in the dish.
l06-dorade-four-chermoula.p: The fish is cooked when the eye turns white and the flesh comes away from the backbone.

s: Fry the garlic in the oil, add the squid for 5 min, then the prawns and whiting in pieces for 4 min, with the spices, salt and lemon.
Off the heat, add the coriander and the konjac vermicelli, rinsed, drained and cut with scissors; drain the filling well in a colander.
Make the fathead dough: melt the mozzarella for 1 min 30 in the microwave, add the almond flour and 1 egg, knead, then divide in two.
Roll each half into a 26 cm disc between two sheets of baking parchment; line a tin with the first disc.
Add the filling, cover with the second disc, seal the edges and brush with the second beaten egg.
Bake for 20 to 25 min at 190 °C, until the pastilla is well browned; rest for 5 min before cutting.
l06-pastilla-fruits-mer-keto.p: The filling must be well drained and cold so the dough doesn't go soggy; it can be made the day before.

s: Gut the sardines, remove the head and backbone by butterflying them; rinse and dry.
Finely chop the herbs and garlic and mix with the spices, lemon, half of the oil and the salt.
Spread a spoonful of chermoula on the flesh side of half of the sardines and cover with a second sardine, skin side out.
Coat the sardines in almond flour, place them on an oiled tray and drizzle with the remaining oil.
Bake for 12 to 15 min at 220 °C, turning halfway, until golden.
l06-sardines-farcies-chermoula.p: Traditionally fried: you can also pan-fry them for 3 min per side in a little olive oil.

s: Brown the merguez cut into pieces for 5 min in the oil, then set aside.
In the same pan, fry the pepper strips and garlic for 5 min.
Add the tomatoes, harissa, spices and a little salt; simmer for 8 min.
Return the merguez, make 6 wells and crack the eggs into them; cover and cook for 5 min, until the whites are set.
Serve directly from the pan.
l06-ojja-merguez.p: A Tunisian speciality: adjust the harissa to your family's taste and offer extra on the side for those who like it hot.

l06-dolma-courgettes-kefta.t: Kefta-stuffed courgette dolma in white sauce
s: Cut the courgettes into 6 cm pieces and hollow them out with a melon baller, keeping a base; set the flesh aside.
Mix the kefta with the egg, half of the parsley, half of the spices and the salt; stuff the pieces.
In a casserole, brown the chicken in the smen with the onion, garlic, remaining spices and the courgette flesh; add 500 ml of water and cook for 15 min.
Stand the stuffed courgettes upright in the sauce, cover and cook for 30 min over low heat.
Add the lemon juice and the remaining parsley, reduce for 5 min and serve.
l06-dolma-courgettes-kefta.p: This is the Algiers-style "dolma" in white sauce; if there is leftover filling, shape it into balls and cook them in the sauce.

l06-cotelettes-agneau-cumin.t: Grilled cumin lamb chops with tomato salad
s: Mix half of the oil with the garlic, cumin, paprika and salt; brush onto the chops and rest for 15 min.
Dice the tomatoes, slice the red onion, then add the parsley, remaining oil and salt.
Grill the chops for 3 to 4 min per side on a very hot grill or barbecue.
Rest for 2 min and serve with the tomato salad and a pinch of cumin.
l06-cotelettes-agneau-cumin.p: For Eid, set out a small dish of cumin mixed with salt for everyone to dip their chop in.

l06-bissara-chou-fleur.t: Keto cauliflower bissara with cumin and olive oil
s: Cook the cauliflower and garlic in 700 ml of salted water for 20 min, until very tender.
Blend with the tahini, half of the cumin and 2 tbsp of oil until you have a thick, velvety purée; add some cooking water if needed.
Return to the heat for 5 min, stirring, to thicken, then add the lemon and adjust the salt.
Serve in bowls, drizzled with a generous amount of olive oil and sprinkled with cumin and paprika.
l06-bissara-chou-fleur.p: True bissara is made from dried fava beans, too high in carbs for keto: cauliflower and tahini reproduce its texture and winter flavour. Add a poached egg for a light dinner.

l06-amlou-keto.t: Keto amlou with almonds and argan oil
s: Roast the almonds for 10 min in the oven at 180 °C, until golden through; let cool.
Blend them for a long time (5 to 8 min), scraping down the sides, until you have a paste that starts to shine.
Add the powdered erythritol, salt and stevia, then pour in the argan oil in a stream while continuing to blend.
Transfer to a jar; the paste should be runny like a spread.
l06-amlou-keto.p: One serving = 2 tbsp, to spread on a keto harcha or msemen. Keeps for 1 month in a jar away from light.

l06-cornes-gazelle-keto.t: Keto gazelle horns with orange blossom water
s: Filling: mix 170 g of almond flour, 60 g of erythritol, 20 g of melted butter, the orange blossom water and cinnamon; shape into 24 small tapered rolls of 6 cm and keep chilled.
Dough: melt the mozzarella and cream cheese for 1 min 30 in the microwave, add the remaining almond flour, the remaining butter, the remaining erythritol and the egg; knead.
Chill the dough for 15 min, then roll it out very thinly (1 to 2 mm) between two sheets of baking parchment.
Cut strips 8 cm wide, place a roll of filling on each, fold the dough over, seal and trim with a pastry wheel; curve into crescents.
Prick each horn with a fork and bake for 12 to 15 min at 170 °C, until just lightly golden.
Cool on a rack before serving with tea.
l06-cornes-gazelle-keto.p: The horns should stay pale: take them out as soon as the underside starts to brown. They keep for 1 week in a tin.

l06-mhalbiya-fleur-oranger.t: Keto mhalbiya with orange blossom water and pistachios
s: In a saucepan, dissolve the agar-agar in the cold almond milk, then add the cream and erythritol.
Bring to the boil, whisking, and boil for 2 min to activate the agar-agar.
Off the heat, add the orange blossom water and pour into 6 ramekins.
Let cool then refrigerate for at least 2 h until the cream is set.
Just before serving, sprinkle with crushed pistachios and a pinch of cinnamon.
l06-mhalbiya-fleur-oranger.p: Agar-agar replaces gelatine and cornflour: the texture stays firm even at room temperature.

l06-jus-amande-fleur-oranger.t: Iced almond milk with orange blossom water
s: Put the almond milk, almond butter, erythritol and orange blossom water in a blender.
Blend for 30 seconds at full speed until the drink is frothy.
Pour over ice in two tall glasses.
Sprinkle with a pinch of cinnamon and serve immediately.
l06-jus-amande-fleur-oranger.p: The keto version of the "almond juice" of Moroccan cafés and weddings; add half an avocado for a more filling smoothie.

l06-cafe-epices-beurre.t: Moroccan spiced coffee (kahwa mkhaltra) with butter
i: kahwa blend: cinnamon, ginger, cardamom, nutmeg, black pepper
s: Brew the coffee with the spice blend (in the filter or the moka pot).
Pour the hot coffee into a blender or a large bowl with the butter, cream and stevia.
Blend for 20 seconds (or whisk with a frother) until creamy and frothy.
Serve immediately in warmed cups.
l06-cafe-epices-beurre.p: The spice blend can be made ahead: 2 tbsp of cinnamon, 1 of ginger, 1 of cardamom, ½ of nutmeg, ½ of black pepper, in a jar.

s: Clean the livers, cut them in half and pat dry.
Heat the oil, sear the livers for 2 min over high heat on all sides, then remove them.
In the same pan, fry the garlic and grated tomato for 4 min, then add the spices, chopped herbs and salt.
Return the livers, add the olives and 50 ml of water; simmer for 6 to 8 min, until the centre of the livers is no longer pink (70 °C).
Drizzle with lemon and serve hot.
l06-kebda-mchermla.p: Rich in iron and very economical; only salt the livers at the end of cooking so they stay tender.
